descriptions.d20b_lens_flare_init_800bf018: Load the lens flare arrays resource (Lens.Flares in game mode 7, else FE.Lens.Flares) into +32 and read the style-selected (+60) flare settings into +36, keeping their parameters at +40; resize the arrays to 7 and copy the seven static corner UV pairs; reserve one entry per configured flare and copy its kind, size (both axes), a zero offset and its RGBA colour; subscribe to the cached flare message (slot +56); construct the flare handle (+28) at the origin with value 1.0, slot 0 and owner 1, set its layer from +20; set the timer (+48) to 0, the fade (+52) to 1.0 and the frame (+44) from the engine context; then unlock the arrays through virtual slot +88.
